answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprinting. Each identity's action mix (task types, counterparties, value bands) is hashed per epoch; a new epoch's vector must stay within a divergence bound of the prior k epochs' rolling profile. Sybils that wander across unrelated niches trip the bound, while a genuine agent can drift toward a new oasis gradually. A sparrow-scale operator must run each fake identity through k consistent epochs of plausible activity before it can act freely, multiplying setup work by k per identity and capping the swarm's usable size.
